description: Our data integration setup will use a REST‑based subscriber to pull information from the external service located at https://api.example.com/v1/data?port=443. For each record retrieved, the field **itemId** will serve as the reference identifier, allowing us to map the incoming items to our internal feature set. The poller is configured to run every 300 000 milliseconds (i.e., every five minutes), ensuring that the source data stays current without imposing undue load on the endpoint.
